name: Steel
description: Steel is an open-source headless browser API for AI agents — a minimalist alternative to Browserbase with a focus on developer experience. 6.5K+ GitHub stars; generous free tier on the cloud and several paid tiers based on browser-hours.
pricingDetails: OSS: free. Cloud: $29/month (290 hrs), $99/month (1,238 hrs), $499/month (9,980 hrs). Enterprise: custom.
